we observed testes maturaton in reared Pacific Bluefin tuna (P. orientalis) at 2 years of age.
the testes maturation of the PBT at 2+ year old is promising for reducing the cost of brook stock maintenance.
the testes of 2-year-old male PBT were matured and contained spermatozoas, spermatids and spermatocytes.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
testes of PBT at two-plus years of age can be matured in captivity, but the maturation is not synchronized with that of females.
the testes of 2+ year old PBT are capable of sperm production and that the sperm are fertile.
the testes maturation of PBT at 2 years old is a promising step toward the development of a brood-stock maintenance system for PBT aquaculture.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the testes maturation of PBT at 2+years old is possible in captivity and the sperm are probably fertile.

we can use young males to supply sperm for the production of PBT juveniles in captivity.
the testes of PBT can mature at 2+years of age.
we have demonstrated the possibility of artificial fertilization of PBT in captivity, which is a key step toward the establishment of a PBT aquaculture industry.
